{{Top}}
The '''Theed Council''' was an organization based on [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], capital [[City/Legends|city]] of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The Council at one point awarded [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] with a [[Theed Council trophy|trophy]], which the politician kept onto well after his conversion into the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]].
